paragraphs: The TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 (L320/L494), Ingenium AJ300D, AJ300P, BMW N63 (L461) is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 (L320/L494), Ingenium AJ300D, AJ300P, BMW N63 (L461) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 (L320/L494), Ingenium AJ300D, AJ300P, BMW N63 (L461) rebuild.

Because the Range Rover Sport HSE uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Range Rover Sport 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 (L320/L494), Ingenium AJ300D, AJ300P, BMW N63 (L461) specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
